name: Huevos a la Mexicana
summary: Eggs scrambled with tomato, onion, and chili, served with refried beans and warm corn tortillas.

ingredients.name: pinto beans, drained (keep a little liquid)

instructions: Mash the beans in a small pot with 1 tbsp oil, a splash of their liquid, and a pinch of salt. Keep warm on low.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large pan over medium heat. Cook the onion 4 minutes, then add the drained tomatoes and chili and cook 3 minutes until most of the liquid is gone.
Beat the eggs with 0.5 tsp salt, pour into the pan, and stir gently until just set.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan, about 20 seconds per side, and keep them wrapped in a towel.
Serve the eggs with the beans and three tortillas per person.

glutenFree.notes: Corn tortillas are naturally gluten-free, but a few brands add wheat flour. Check the label.

budgetNotes: Substitution: chili powder replaces fresh serrano or jalapeño, which are often sold only in bulk packs here. The taste changes: fresh chilies add bright, grassy heat and a bit of crunch, while chili powder is earthier, milder and blends into the sauce. Use one fresh pepper, finely chopped, if you have it.
The colours are meant to match the Mexican flag: red tomato, white onion, green chili.
Drain the tomatoes well or the eggs go watery.
